label.explanation: notifications was restored from a snapshot but its id AUTO_INCREMENT was left behind the restored rows (line 191). New inserts are handed ids that already exist and violate the primary key (lines 223, 228, 234, 242, 255). notification-svc's create failures (lines 226, 257, 281, 310, 325, 339) and api-gateway errors (lines 218, 235, 249, 259, 276, 287, 293, 311, 317, 326, 333, 338) follow. Reset the sequence past max(id). Red herrings: line 57 (a certificate expiry reminder weeks out); lines 179, 186 (a deploy of notif-worker, which is not on the failing request path and kept processing normally); line 225 (a one-off slow reporting query on audit_log, not on the failing request path).
